To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

appreciation as audience response is a distinct and important type of media enjoyment, which can be conceptualized and operationalized as a separate entertainment gratification, and which is related to the hedonic gratification of fun and suspense, and to perceptions of entertainment as long lasting.
appreciation, as an entertainment gratification, is an important predictor of long-term effects on entertainment experiences.
the entertainment experience is multidimensional, and that appreciation is a gratification that can be empirically distinguished from hedonism and that is related to more long-lasting effects.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of what makes a film or television show entertaining and what makes it enjoyable, and we propose that appreciation is an important part of the answer to these questions.
the question of how viewers experience and evaluate entertainment.
the role of entertainment gratifications in the media experience and how they may contribute to the understanding of media enjoyment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the present study has shown that appreciation is an independent and important dimension of media enjoyment.
entertainment is a complex, multifaceted phenomenon that can be conceptualized and measured in different ways.
entertainment is not just fun and suspense, and that it does not only have hedonic effects, but can also have a positive impact on viewers in a more cognitive, emotional, and social way.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the more serious and thought-provoked the entertainment, the greater the perceived long-term impact on the viewer.
we have found evidence for two distinct, yet interrelated types of entertainment gratifications: fun and suspense on the one hand, and moving and thought-proving on the other.
the gratification of being entertained can be more complex and multifaceted than previously thought.
The main takeaway from our work is that
appreciation is a distinct type of entertainment gratification that can be empirically measured and that it can be used to explain the effects of entertainment media on audience members.
entertainment is not a one-dimensional concept.
the hedonistic perspective on media enjoyment needs to be complemented by a more serious, poignant and pensive perspective on the nature of entertainment gratifications.
